text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
One day, on the outskirts of Landosol,
{0} sees Tamaki surrounded by many cats.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}はある日、ランドソルの郊外で
大勢の猫を集めているタマキを見かけた。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, {0}!
Thanks fur the other day!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、{0}！
先日はどうもありがとうにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
What am I doing?
Can you nyot tell? I'm feeding the cats!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何をしてるかって……？
それは当然、
猫にエサをあげてるのにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: I'm the one who looks after all the cats around here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この辺りの猫は、
全部あたしが世話をしてるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Well?
Are you im-purr-essed?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっへん！
驚いたかにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Although to be honest, taking care of and feeding
all of them is claw-fully expensive.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
こんなに大勢の猫の面倒を見ていると、
さすがにエサ代もバカににゃらないけどにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I know you think I'm stingy, but someone's gotta paw the bill
to feed my furry friends. I'm nyot just a miser, you know?
choice_data_list: Why do you go out of your way to look after the cats?
You really like cats, don't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}は、
あたしのことをケチだと
思ってるかもしれにゃいけど、
この子たちのエサ代を
稼ぐ必要もあるし、
ただのケチンボじゃないのにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: 'Cause they're suuu-purr cute! I love 'em!
text_block_list.orig_text:
猫が可愛くて、
大好きだからにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I love 'em!
They're the meow-st cutest things in the world!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろんにゃ！　
大好きにゃ！
可愛くてたまらないのにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Besides, taming cats has its own purr-sonal benefits.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
猫は飼いならせば何かと役に立つのにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
What benefits, you ask?
Nyow, that's a secret!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何の役に立つのかって？
それは秘密にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Kitten
text_block_list.text: Meow!
text_block_list.orig_text: にゃあー

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
What's the matter, little fella?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……にゃ？
お前、
どうかしたかにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myahah... Want me to stroke you?
Well, since you asked so nicely...
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃはは、
あたしに撫でてほしいのかにゃ？
だったら、
そのリクエストにお応えしてあげるにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Here you go. Do you pre-fur your belly?
Or your neck?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほれほれ、
お腹がいいのかにゃ？
喉がいいのかにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep stroking you until you're cat-isfied.
Who's a good little kitty? ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前が満足するまで、
たっぷりと撫でてあげるにゃ。
ごろごろごろー♪

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myahah...
You know, {0}, this little kitten reminds me of you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃはは。
何だかこの子猫、
{0}に似てるのにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I haven't named this one yet,
so purr-haps I'll go with {0}.
choice_data_list: Don't just use my name without asking—
text_block_list.orig_text:
名前、
まだ決めてなかったけど、
{0}にしちゃおっかにゃー

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Too late nyow. Complain all you like,
but this cat will fur-ever be called {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう決定したのにゃ。
{0}がいくら文句を言おうと、
この子猫の名前はキミと同じなのにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Kitten
text_block_list.text: Meow!
text_block_list.orig_text: にゃー

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Myahah! Nyow there, I think he likes his new name!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃはは、
この子も名前、
気に入ったみたいにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Myahah!
Don't lick me so much, {0}!
What a nyaughty little boy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
にゃはは！
{0}、そんなに舐めちゃダメにゃ！
もう、
いやらしい子だにゃあ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
I'm talking to the cat, nyot you.
No need to look so ap-paw-lled.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……にゃ？
別に{0}のことじゃにゃいんだから、
そんな微妙な顔しないでほしいのにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Come on, {0}.
Play with me and mini {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、{0}も、
あたしと一緒に猫と遊ぶのにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: One week later—
text_block_list.orig_text: それから一週間後──

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
choice_data_list: You look like you're about to cry. Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
One of my meowst favorite kittens disappeared...
The one I named after you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
かわいがってた猫が一匹、
いなくなっちゃったにゃ……
キミと同じ名前を付けた、
あの子猫にゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
He's still a baby, so he can't feed himself.
Where could he have paw-sibly gone...?
choice_data_list: I'll help. Let's go look for him now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだ子猫だから、
きっと食べるものがなくて困ってるにゃ……
どこに行っちゃったのにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: You're gonna help me?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……手伝ってくれるのかにゃ……？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks fur trying to cheer me up.
Hey! Where are you going?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……慰めてくれて、
ありがとにゃ。
って、
どこに行くにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: You'll look fur him? You mean, you're gonna help me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
探してみるって……
もしかして、
手伝ってくれるのかにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: ...Really? Thank you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……本当にゃ？　
ありがとうにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: All right, let's go find him nyow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
早速探しに行くにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
{0}!
Where are you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}ー！
どこにいるにゃー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: If you're there, then meow something!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いるなら
返事をしてほしいにゃー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... He's nyowhere to be found.
Maybe something cat-astrophic happened to him...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメにゃ……
やっぱり、見つからないにゃ。
こんな時間まで見つからないってことは
もしかして……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
What's that? Don't give up?
...There you go again, cheering me up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
諦めるな、
って……？
……また慰められちゃったのにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
It's only been a day since he disappeared.
I'm nyot giving up until we find him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうにゃ。
まだいなくなってからたったの１日にゃ。
絶対に見つけてみせるのにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
{0}!
If you can hear my voice, then meow that you're there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}ー！！
あたしの声が聞こえたなら、
返事をしてほしいにゃー！

text_block_list.name: Kitten
text_block_list.text: Meow...
text_block_list.orig_text: にゃー……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
That cry...
Where's it coming from?
text_block_list.orig_text:
この鳴き声は……
どこから聞こえるにゃ！？

text_block_list.name: Kitten
text_block_list.text: Meow...
text_block_list.orig_text: にゃー……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
I found him! He's on the roof of this house!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！
見つけた、
この家の屋根の上にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: He must've climbed too high and fur-got how to get down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
きっと、
高いところに登りすぎて、
降りられなくなったのにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hold on!
I'm coming to get you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ってるにゃ！
あたしが今、
助けてあげるのにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Kitten
text_block_list.text: Meow! Meow!
text_block_list.orig_text: にゃー、にゃー

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Aww. There's a good boy. Nyo more wandering off like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
いい子いい子にゃ。
もう迷子になっちゃダメにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Your little paws are trembling...
I'm here nyow, so don't you worry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなに震えて……
あたしがついてるから、
もう安心するにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks fur helping me out today, {0}!
You're a real fur-end to me, just like the cats!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日は、
子猫を探してくれてありがとにゃ、{0}！
やっぱりキミも、
猫みたいにかわいいところあるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll give you another paw-some discount
as a thank-you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お礼に今度、
また割引で何か売ってあげるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Why is it never free?
Hehe... You'll need my unconditional love for that,
and it comes at a hefty purr-ice.
text_block_list.orig_text:
結局割引なのかって？　
んー……
あたしの無償の愛なんて、
よっぽどのことがないと
得られないのにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
After all, I'm a whimsical cat!
But that also means I might just give you something
for free someday. Purr-haps?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって、
あたしは気まぐれな猫ちゃんだもんにゃ！
……ま、
気まぐれだから、
そのうちイイコトもあるかも。
しれないけどにゃ……？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nyow then, I'll be taking this little fella home.
See ya around! Bye-bye!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃああたしは、
この子をお家に連れて帰ってあげるにゃ。
またにゃ、
ばいばい！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: With a smile on her face, Tamaki headed off to take the kitten home.
text_block_list.orig_text: タマキは笑顔で子猫を連れ帰るのだった。
